$note: What each control drives and where its state persists. Authored JS (s258-D1): the page's own wiring, starting from the snippets' contracts; chart engine blocks carried verbatim as AUTO-BEHAVIOUR splices.

controls.entity/region/period dropdowns: re-drive every KPI, chart, grid and panel; persist in the URL query and localStorage
controls.applied-filter chips and Clear all: remove one or all filters; same persistence
controls.side nav, breadcrumbs, KPI tiles, panel: hash route #/view[/record]; drawer opens from the URL
controls.nav rail toggle: App-shell-side-nav contract, re-authored; persists in localStorage
controls.theme segmented controls (header and set: html[data-theme]; persists in URL ?theme= and localStorage
controls.exposure bar and currency slice: drill through to Risk and limits, filtered
controls.Approve / Reject payment: validated, modal confirm, audit trail; persists in localStorage
controls.Request drawdown: validated amount and business date; persists
controls.Run report, Download CSV, Export CSV: client-side CSV from DATA in scope
